title: THE UPDATE BROKE KULDRA?! Can We Beat the Boss Again? | Dragonwilds LIVE
author: Killed90 Gaming
description:
Welcome back to Stream 24 of our RuneScape: Dragonwilds adventure!

We've beaten the game, but the adventure isn't over yet! The latest update seems to have changed things with Kuldra, the final boss, so today we're going back to test the fight and figure out what's different. Can we still beat Kuldra, or has the update thrown a wrench into our strategy?

Alongside the boss testing, I'll be gathering Ascension Shards to work toward leveling up more Masterworks, and we might do some building as well.

Our community world has grown a lot and now supports up to 6 players! We're also on day nine of our server running 24/7 for Discord members, so the world can keep growing even when I'm offline.

As always, we'll be hanging out with chat, talking games, testing the update, and figuring things out together.

**Today's Plans:**
- Test the latest update and see what's changed with Kuldra
- Figure out how to beat the final boss after the update
- Gather Ascension Shards for more Masterwork upgrades
- Maybe work on some building in our community world
- Hang out and talk with chat

**Want to join our community world?**

Join the Killed90 Gaming Discord at https://Discord.gg/ZSnum9RSUa for details on accessing our 6-player community server, available 24/7 for Discord members.

Come hang out and help us figure out this update. Can we take down Kuldra again, or are we in for a surprise?
